pathways.diagnosticCriteriaSummary: 5+ symptoms during same 2-week period including depressed mood or anhedonia (DSM-5-TR).

firstLine.rationale: High tolerability, minimal CYP drug-drug interactions. Great for mixed depression & anxiety.
Preferred in cardiac patients; mild activating effect at higher doses.
Zero sexual side effects, weight-neutral/weight loss, energizing. Best for lethargy, fatigue, or comorbid ADHD. (Contraindicated in seizure/eating disorders).

secondLine.rationale: Dual 5-HT and NE reuptake inhibition. Ideal if SSRI response is partial or if chronic pain/fibromyalgia is present.
Different mechanism (NaSSA). Promotes appetite and restorative sleep. Excellent for insomnia and low BMI.

augmentationStrategies.rationale: Addresses residual fatigue, anhedonia, and alleviates SSRI-induced sexual dysfunction.
Evidence-based rapid augmentation for treatment-resistant depression.
Recommended when subthreshold bipolarity or chronic treatment-resistance exists.

pathways.diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Excessive anxiety and worry occurring more days than not for at least 6 months across multiple events (DSM-5-TR).

firstLine.rationale: Cleanest side-effect profile; start at 5mg for 7-10 days to minimize initial paradoxical anxiety.
Broad-spectrum anxiolytic efficacy (GAD, panic, OCD, social anxiety). Start at 25mg.
SNRI indicated for GAD; effective when chronic somatic anxiety or muscle tension is prominent.

adjunctiveOptions.rationale: Non-controlled 5-HT1A partial agonist. Must be taken scheduled BID/TID; does not cause sedation or dependence.
Non-addictive H1 antihistamine for PRN acute anxiety episodes without controlled-substance risks.

pathways.diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Persistent pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity interfering with functioning, with symptoms originating prior to age 12.
ruleOuts: Severe primary anxiety/depression causing executive dysfunction

firstLine.rationale: Prodrug with smooth 12-14 hour therapeutic curve and lower abuse liability compared to IR stimulants.
Dual-bead delivery with proven clinical efficacy; covers workday 8-10 hours.
OROS delivery technology providing steady osmotic release; well-tolerated baseline stimulant.

nonStimulantAlternatives.rationale: First-line non-controlled NRI option when patient has personal/family history of substance use disorder, severe anxiety, or cardiovascular risk.
Dopaminergic/noradrenergic tone can improve mild executive dysfunction while addressing comorbid depressive symptoms.
Alpha-2A adrenergic agonists; beneficial for emotional dysregulation, rejection sensitivity, and sleep disruption.
